pages.text: The original TNT remains while an extra charge is primed. The mimic remembers the traces left by piston, rail and coral.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)TNT$(br)Dead Tube Coral Fan$(br)Detector Rail$(br)Slime Block$(br)Sticky Piston$(br)Rune Plate: Moving Blocks$(br)Rune Plate: Impact$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation
